thread:
marie: Heads up — around a deploy at 22:07 we stopped paging for a subset of customers; some 504s reported by support. incident-bot tried to page but I see no acks.
incident-bot: automated page: channel=#incidents, target=@ops-oncall, status=delivered, ack=null, meta={\"route\":\"pager-proxy\",\"attempt\":1}
ops-oncall: I'm oncall, I'll pick it up. any known deploy id?
marie: deploy-bot posted id `deploy_2026_03_18_2207` to #eng-releases just before. Looks correlated.
josh: checking pager-proxy logs now. quick check: `kubectl logs -n infra pager-proxy-0 | tail -n 200`
marie: FYI support says ~45 customers saw intermittent 504s for ~4 minutes, most recovered.
ops-oncall: I see entries where the incident-bot callback returned 200 but the pager gateway didn't forward. Snippet:
```
2026-03-18T22:07:12Z INFO incoming page id=abc123 route=pager-proxy status=queued
2026-03-18T22:07:13Z ERROR forward failed id=abc123 to=sms-gw reason=403-forbidden
2026-03-18T22:07:13Z WARN ack not received id=abc123
```
sam: 403 to sms-gw looks like credential rotation. Did we rotate signing keys during that deploy?
linda: yes, key rotation job ran in the release. ops-runbook suggests hot-swap but maybe the new key didn't prop through the proxy cache.
josh: confirmed: the new KID was in the private KMS, but pager-proxy's env var `PAGER_SIGNING_KID` still pointed to old KID until process restart. No restart was triggered by the deployment because the proxy changed only a ConfigMap.
incident-bot: paging automation: fallback policy attempted: send to oncall-sms-fallback, status=failed, reason=403
ops-oncall: I'm adding a manual page now and pinging primary oncall via phone. manual pages going out.
marie: can we get a quick mitigation? restart pager-proxy to pick up new key.
josh: doing a rolling restart: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/pager-proxy -n infra` — will post progress.
josh: pod pager-proxy-0 terminated, pager-proxy-1 started, readiness ok.
ops-oncall: got the manual page and acknowledged. :thumbsup:
sam: monitoring for residual 504s and missed pages. setting a short alert for `pager_proxy_forward_errors > 0` with 1m window.
linda: support confirms new pages delivered after 22:11. customers recovering.
marie: root cause hypothesis: key rotation + config map change didn't trigger proxy restart, causing mismatch and 403 from sms gateway which in turn blocked automated paging. fallback policies also failed due to same credentials.
ops-oncall: action items for now: 1) postmortem, 2) change rotate keys job to also touch deployment annotation to force restart, 3) add `forward_errors` alert to runbook, 4) add safe-mode fallback to incident-bot to try HTTPS fallback route. I'll create tickets.
sam: logging note: incident-bot should surface gateway response codes in the thread automatically so live triage sees 4xx/5xx reasons inline.
marie: thanks all. small customer impact but paging automation gap is high-risk. I'll open the incident and tag infra+oncall for follow up.
deploy-bot: rollback not required — deploy completed, no app regressions observed. marking deploy as stable.
josh: saving logs to the incident channel: `s3://redwood-logs/incidents/1766459999/` for postmortem.
marie: assigning follow-ups and will draft a short summary for execs. good job catching it quickly. :slightly_smiling_face:
